```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(message = FALSE, warning = FALSE)

setwd(here::here())

library("haven")
library("tidyverse")
library(lme4)

getwd()

source("./scripts/preprocessing.R")
source("./scripts/lazy-functions-v2.R")
```

# Distribution of simplified response types at T1, by Condition.

Note: All midpoint types collapsed to value 3


```{r, echo=FALSE}

all_simple_pre <- table_maker(
  df = all_changes,
  var1 = "Condition",
  var2 = "pre_simple",
  stats = "counts"
)

barplot_maker(df = all_changes, 
              var1 = 'Condition', 
              var2 = "pre_simple",
              main = "Simplified Answers Per Condition - T1",
              xlab = "Response Type",
    legend_labels = c(
  "Control\nCondition\n",
  "Ambivalence\nCondition\n",
  "Integration\nCondition\n"
),
margins = NULL)

```


Given that there is imbalance in the number of participants per condition, look at proportions as well.

Note: in the table, proportions sum to 1.00 row-wise.

```{r, echo=FALSE}

all_simple_pre_prop <- table_maker(
  df = all_changes,
  var1 = "Condition",
  var2 = "pre_simple",
  stats = "props"
)

barplot_maker(df = all_changes, 
              var1 = 'Condition', 
              var2 = "pre_simple",
              use_prop = TRUE,
              main = "Simplified Answer Proportions Per Condition - T1",
              xlab = "Response Type",
    legend_labels = c(
  "Control\nCondition\n",
  "Ambivalence\nCondition\n",
  "Integration\nCondition\n"
),
              margins = NULL)



```
